summary: Iteration 3 frontend verification (viewport 390x844). All six requested flows pass. (1) Savings card: Created ServA USD monthly 1.000,00 usage=low -> reports-savings-total-USD shows 'USD 12.000,00' and reports-savings-row-<A>. Created ServB ARS quarterly 30.000 with no usage -> appears under reports-savings-unrated with chips reports-savings-usage-<B>-{high,medium,low}. Tapping reports-savings-usage-<B>-low adds ARS row and shows reports-savings-total-ARS '$ 120.000,00' separately from USD (no currency mixing). Values persist after reload (USD 12.000,00 and $ 120.000,00). (2) Service detail shows 'Uso declarado: Lo uso poco' matching USAGE_LABEL[low]. (3) Cancelled service excluded: cancelling the only usage=low service via service-detail-cancel + cancel-sheet-confirm removes it from savings card (card returns null when recurringCount=0, 'No hay servicios recurrentes activos'). (4) Privacy screen loads sections including '6. Uso limitado de los datos de Google', mentions 'gmail.readonly', contact 'ezequiel21lv@gmail.com', and privacy-url 'https://eze2122.github.io/-subly-privacy/privacy.html'. (5) Gmail screen: no crash, status 'No conectado', notice gmail-unavailable 'Disponible en Android · La conexión con Gmail está disponible en la app de Android.', gmail-connect-button aria-disabled=true, never shows 'Conectado'. (6) Regression: create/save flow works, service detail loads with Confirmar pago / Marcar como cancelado, backup-export-csv testID present. Form segmented control testID service-form-usage with options -none/-high/-medium/-low verified. Non-blocking RN-Web warnings persist (shadow* deprecated) - cosmetic only.

react_native_issues.issue: Non-blocking warnings in web preview: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow"'. Cosmetic for web only; irrelevant on native Android build.

critical_code_review_comments: src/domain/stats.ts savingsSummary correctly excludes cancelled services and recurring-ended services; annual uses monthlyEquivalent(s)*12 per currency with no cross-currency mixing (CurrencyTotals keyed by s.currency). Verified: USD 1.000,00 monthly -> 12.000,00/yr, ARS 30.000 quarterly -> 120.000,00/yr (30.000*4).
src/components/SavingsCard.tsx returns null when recurringCount=0 (card disappears when all are cancelled) - matches observed behavior.
app/service/form.tsx Segmented testID 'service-form-usage' with options 'none/high/medium/low' maps to data-testid 'service-form-usage-<id>' - verified present in DOM.
app/service/[id].tsx shows 'Uso declarado' with USAGE_LABEL mapping (low -> 'Lo uso poco').
app/privacy.tsx renders PRIVACY_SECTIONS and PRIVACY_URL from src/domain/privacyPolicy.ts; section '6. Uso limitado de los datos de Google' includes Limited Use language in both ES and EN.
src/gmail/oauth.ts oauthAvailability() returns {ok:false, reason:'platform'} on web -> UI correctly surfaces notice and disables button; no 'email' scope present (only gmail.readonly).
